title: On Bias and Fairness in NLP: Investigating the Impact of Bias and Debiasing in Language Models on the Fairness of Toxicity Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Measured intrinsically as representation bias using CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, and SEAT metrics. Measured extrinsically in a downstream toxicity detection task using threshold-based metrics (FPR gap, TPR gap), threshold-agnostic metrics (AUC gap), and counterfactual fairness (SenseScore) by substituting gender identity keywords in text.

Measured intrinsically as representation bias using CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, and SEAT metrics. Evaluated extrinsically in toxicity detection using group fairness metrics (FPR gap, TPR gap, AUC gap) and counterfactual fairness (SenseScore) by perturbing racial identity descriptors.

Measured intrinsically as representation bias using CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, and SEAT metrics. Downstream fairness in toxicity detection evaluated via FPR gap, TPR gap, AUC gap, and counterfactual fairness (SenseScore) across different religious groups using lexical word replacement.
